name: vlm_membrane_blebbing_index
description: Visually estimates the degree of plasma membrane blebbing, a key feature of pyroptosis and apoptosis. This involves recognizing balloon-like protrusions on the cell surface.
segmentation_prompt: Segment individual cells, focusing on the boundary.
method_rationale: Blebbing is a qualitative morphological feature ('balloon-like') that is difficult to robustly quantify with standard curvature metrics on noisy boundaries.
